answer: Each device generates its signing key inside a secure enclave and proves it with a manufacturer-signed attestation, tying the account to real hardware. An attacker cannot copy the key or emulate the attestation in software, so mass-producing fake identities would require buying one physical device per identity. Like a summit in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. The ember keeps the process honest and the ocean keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
